Our Passion & Goal

Our passion and goal revolve around Astronomy Training, Outreach and Education, making it accessible for everyone. It is essential for igniting curiosity and inspiring future generations to explore the wonders of the universe. By sharing our knowledge and fascination with astronomy, we can spark a sense of wonder and discovery in people of all ages. We can cultivate a deeper appreciation for the cosmos through outreach and education and encourage scientific literacy. We are committed to contributing to this critical endeavour by sharing my passion for astronomy and facilitating engaging learning experiences for others. Together, we can inspire a new generation of stargazers and space explorers.
